name: find_elderly_patients
description: Find all patients older than 65 years
question: Find all patients older than 65 years
generated_sql: SELECT patient_id, first_name, last_name, age FROM patients WHERE age > 65 ORDER BY patient_id;

name: hypertension_patients
description: Retrieve patient IDs diagnosed with essential hypertension (code I10)
question: Which patients have essential hypertension?
generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM conditions WHERE code = 'I10' ORDER BY patient_id;

name: high_a1c_observations
description: Find observations where HbA1c is above 7.5%
question: List all observations with HbA1c above 7.5%
generated_sql: SELECT obs_id, patient_id, value_numeric FROM observations WHERE code = '4548-4' AND value_numeric > 7.5;
